notes_for_editor: Both pages agree on the 1935 build and the tower being gone by 1963. The FFLA list agrees on tower and gone, and also has a separate Vermillion Peak site listed as a ground-level cab that is gone. Nothing found shows it is the tower that may have been replaced, so the story keeps that as a hedge. Two WebSearches found no Disgrace Butte page and only other towers (Lookout Butte, Elk Butte), which were not used. The staff names come from the Idaho Fire Lookouts staff list, which cites a former register; the editor may want to confirm the names should stay in the public story. Record agency was null and is filled from both pages. Tower height is given as 30 ft and not converted to height_m, because cab-floor height is not stated.
